title: Billie Eilish I-10 album/Coachella boards
what_it_showed: Minimal imagery with scribbled text promoting her latest album (When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go?, per release timing - the source says only 'latest album') and her Coachella performance. No verbatim text reported.
location: Interstate 10, on the route leading to the concert and campgrounds (no direction or cross street reported)
promoted: Latest album and her Coachella 2019 set (first Coachella appearance, Saturday, weekends 1 and 2)

sources.publication: OAAA (Out of Home Advertising Association of America) blog - 'Billboards Headlining at Coachella'
MarkMeets - 'What We Can Learn From the Phenomenon of Coachella Billboards' (secondary, cites unnamed 'industry advertising reports')

image_sources.credit: Dash Two (ad agency) - image alt text 'Billie Eilish' in a 'Guide-To-Coachella-2020' upload set; year and placement not stated on the page
image_sources.photo_type: agency/official (unverified that it is the same board)

notes: Only one solid source (OAAA trade blog). Billboard (2022) separately lists 'Billie Eilish's Adobe campaign' as MilkMoney agency work, with no year or location - not confirmed to be the same thing.

title: Jackrabbit, Cottontail & Spirits of the Desert
what_it_showed: Enlarged photographs of four young Chemehuevi boys as 'time-traveling visitors' returning to ancestral lands; one shows a figure running in front of the Palm Springs wind turbines, another shows all four boys in headdresses beneath the text 'NO WALL'.
location: Gene Autry Trail, Palm Springs - northbound between Via Escuela (also given as Vista Chino) and the 10 Freeway (Cactus Hugs). OAAA describes it as 'a billboard on the 10 Freeway'. Desert X lists coordinates 33.853965, -116.506052.
promoted: Desert X 2019 biennial (Feb 9 - Apr 21, 2019), overlapping Coachella 2019. Not a Coachella artist promo.
aftermath: Temporary installation; ended with Desert X 2019.

sources.publication: The Spaces - 'Billboards bring Native American culture into the spotlight at Desert X' (Annabel Herrick)
Cactus Hugs - Desert X 2019 guide to the Jackrabbit billboard installation
OAAA blog
Desert X (official artist page)

notes: Sources conflict on count: The Spaces says five billboards, Cactus Hugs says four. Included because it is a Palm Springs approach-road billboard during festival season; it is art, not festival promotion.

title: Coachella 2020 cancelled - booked boards cancelled
what_it_showed: No artist billboard found. Billboard reports that Dash Two (LA out-of-home agency, Gino Sesto) had booked 20 Coachella billboards in 2020, all of which were cancelled when the festival shut down.
aftermath: Billboard also reports car dealers and casinos stopped carving Coachella-weekend space out of their year-round contracts after the 2020 and 2021 cancellations.

sources.publication: Billboard (Pro) - 'On the Road to Coachella? Those Billboards Are There Just for You'

notes: Searches for any artist/teaser board that stayed up in April 2020 returned nothing.

title: Because You Know Ultimately We Will Band A Militia
what_it_showed: A series of billboards in standard ad typography with public-domain Met images and text statements. Quoted lines: 'You Are Entering the Reparations Framework'; 'California Once Tried to Ban Black People.'; 'You Keep Our Most Brilliant Minds in a Perpetual Loop of Articulating and Translating the Ramifications of Your Systemic Generational Plunder.'; 'We call for radical distribution of resources because economic precarity is another form of harm.' (beside a portrait of Marsha P. Johnson); 'Rupture your guilt amnesia.'
location: Gene Autry Trail, Palm Springs, between Via Escuela and Interstate 10 (Time Out). PBS SoCal notes a Rocky's Pawn Shop billboard ('Make America Great') stands opposite.
promoted: Desert X 2021 (Mar 12 - May 16, 2021), held in the year Coachella was cancelled. Not a festival promo.

sources.publication: PBS SoCal Artbound - 'Palm Springs Billboards Prompt Heavy Road Trip Conversations' (Rohini Walker)
Time Out Los Angeles - '6 installations to see at Desert X 2021' (Michael Juliano)
LAist - Desert X returns with political statements

image_sources.credit: Lance Gerber (main + slideshows); Martin Mancha (Rocky's/installation gallery)
Lance Gerber, courtesy the artist and Desert X

notes: Board count not given; a PBS caption mentions four in a line. Only 2021 billboard found in the valley; no Coachella-related artist billboard found for 2021.

title: Utopia 'Wrong Way' boards
what_it_showed: Four sequential billboards: 'PSST….' (also rendered 'Psst…….'), 'Looking for UTOPIA?', 'WRONG WAY!', then the Cactus Jack logo (fourth board reportedly logo only).
location: Off I-10, on the side headed away from the Coachella festival grounds in Indio (Complex, Highsnobiety, The Fader). Uproxx says only 'near the Coachella grounds'. Billboard (Pro) places the 'PSST . . . Looking for UTOPIA?' board on I-10 between Riverside and Indio.
promoted: Teased the long-delayed album Utopia, during the festival Scott had been removed from headlining after the Astroworld tragedy.
aftermath: Utopia was released July 28, 2023 (release date from general record, not from the cited articles).

title: 'Heterosexuality Can Be Cured'
what_it_showed: Bold red type on yellow: 'HETEROSEXUALITY CAN BE CURED' / 'JUST WATCH OMAR APOLLO ON FRIDAY'.
location: Interstate 10, right-hand side for drivers coming from Los Angeles, around the Palm Springs area en route to Indio (PRIDE). Billboard (Pro): I-10, Riverside to Indio.
promoted: His Friday set at Coachella 2022 (first Coachella appearance); debut album Ivory had been announced Feb 2022.
aftermath: Widely cited in later 'best Coachella billboards' lists (Gen Admission 2024 ranked it #1; The Forty-Five 2024 cited it as precedent for Sabrina Carpenter's boards).

title: 'Drop Beats Not Bombs'
what_it_showed: Blue-and-yellow (Ukrainian flag colors) boards; one side reads 'Drop Beats', the other 'Not Bombs' (The Fader). New Hit Singles renders it 'DROP BEATS NOT BOMBS'.
location: Along the highway leading to and from the festival grounds in Indio (The Fader); 'on the road into Coachella' (New Hit Singles). Road not named.
promoted: Fundraising for Ukraine via the nonprofit Music Saves UA (vamp.org.ua), during Coachella weekend 2.
aftermath: Matoma was asked about the boards in an August 2022 EDMTunes interview.
